benefitsPage.heroSubtitle: At MWG Group, we are committed to bringing a happy working environment where employees can dedicate themselves with comprehensive benefits and outstanding remuneration.
benefitsPage.basicBenefitsDesc: Competitive salary & bonus policy, comprehensive social & health insurance, and outstanding performance bonuses.
benefitsPage.basicHighlight1: Competitive salary commensurate with capability and contribution value
benefitsPage.basicHighlight2: Attractive monthly/quarterly sales and KPI performance bonuses
benefitsPage.basicHighlight3: 13th-month salary, Lunar New Year bonuses, and major holiday rewards
benefitsPage.basicHighlight4: 100% full coverage of social, health, and unemployment insurance under Labor Law
benefitsPage.basicHighlight5: Periodic salary review 1-2 times per year
benefitsPage.preferentialBuyingDesc: Exclusive staff discounts when purchasing products across all MWG retail chains including TGĐĐ, Điện Máy Xanh, An Khang, AVAKids...
benefitsPage.discountHighlight1: Special discounts up to 20% - 30% when purchasing electronics, laptops, phones at TGĐĐ & Điện máy XANH
benefitsPage.discountHighlight2: Discount privileges when purchasing consumer goods and fresh food at Bách hóa XANH
benefitsPage.discountHighlight3: Discounted medicine and healthcare products at An Khang Pharmacy
benefitsPage.discountHighlight4: 0% interest installment plan exclusively for official employees
benefitsPage.discountHighlight5: Birthday gift vouchers and New Year gifts for employees' families
benefitsPage.engagementProgramsDesc: Vibrant annual Team Building activities, national sports festivals, birthday celebrations, and engaging team bonding cultural events.
benefitsPage.engagementHighlight1: Annual group-wide vacation trips and Team Building retreats
benefitsPage.engagementHighlight2: MWG Sports festival, football leagues, marathons, and arts performances
benefitsPage.engagementHighlight3: Monthly birthday parties and annual MWG Family Day
benefitsPage.engagementHighlight4: Youthful and dynamic work culture with supportive teammates
benefitsPage.engagementHighlight5: Interest clubs: Football, Badminton, Yoga, Esports, Music...
benefitsPage.healthcareDesc: High-quality annual health checkups, premium personal health insurance packages, and special medical assistance for employees and families.
benefitsPage.healthcareHighlight1: Annual comprehensive health checkups at prestigious international hospitals
benefitsPage.healthcareHighlight2: Premium health insurance (MWG Care) covering inpatient, outpatient, and 24/7 accident care
benefitsPage.healthcareHighlight3: Extended health insurance coverage for family relatives (spouse, children)
benefitsPage.healthcareHighlight4: Online medical consultation and emergency assistance from specialist doctors
benefitsPage.healthcareHighlight5: Care leave policy and generous maternity support
benefitsPage.feature1Desc: 100% compliance with Labor Code regulations and expanded employee benefits.
benefitsPage.feature2Desc: Outstanding performance bonus policy recognizing positive contributions of every individual.
benefitsPage.feature3Desc: Warm and supportive workplace with sharing colleagues focused on long-term engagement.
